home.title: AutoDial AI — Autonomous Sales Call Platform
home.description: Deploy an AI-powered autonomous sales agent that makes outbound calls, handles objections, and notifies you when prospects convert.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.desc: The page you are looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

landing.heroHeading1: Your AI sales agent calls leads
landing.heroSub: AutoDial AI deploys an autonomous sales agent that makes outbound calls on your behalf, handles objections, and emails you the moment a prospect shows interest or converts.
landing.howSubtitle: From registration to your first autonomous call in minutes.
landing.howStep1Desc: Sign up with your company details. Our team activates your subscription.
landing.howStep2Desc: Describe your product, pitch, tone, and how to handle objections.
landing.howStep3Desc: Import a CSV/Excel list or let AI find matching leads for you.
landing.howStep4Desc: Your agent calls leads and emails you on every interest or conversion.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to scale outbound
landing.featuresSubtitle: A complete autonomous outbound calling stack.
landing.feature1Desc: We initiate calls automatically against your lead list using your connected dialer.
landing.feature2Desc: The pitch adapts to your config and learns from call outcomes over time.
landing.feature3Desc: Configure how your agent responds to common objections like pricing or timing.
landing.feature4Desc: Specify industry, geography, and size — we search and build your list automatically.
landing.feature5Desc: Receive detailed email notifications the moment a prospect shows interest.
landing.feature6Desc: Track connection, interest, and conversion rates over any period.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Choose a plan and get started. No payment processing on the platform — billing is managed by our team.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to launch your AI sales team?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Register your business and start configuring your autonomous agent today.

pricing.title: Pricing plans
pricing.subtitle: Start free and scale as your outbound volume grows. Billing is managed by our team — plan and subscription status are set after we confirm payment.
pricing.helpText: Our platform team will help you pick the plan that matches your call volume. Reach out and we'll activate you in no time.
